thread:
rafa: Quick sync — I ran a cross-region KV-cache bench to investigate 'sloshing' (churn) with a mixed sequence-length distribution. Comparing eu-west (a100) vs us-east (h100). Observed different tail behavior and hit-rate/latency tradeoffs.
bench-bot: Uploaded summary + charts to /charts/kv-slosh/. Short numbers below; full csv attached to run.
min: Can you paste the exact slen distribution and model/quant flags used?
rafa: slen mix = 60% <=64, 30% 65-512, 10% >512. Model = llama-13B quant-4f16. Kernel sets: a100 cluster used attn_legacy + pagerized kv; h100 used fused_attn_v2 + prefetch.
devin: Noted. On a100 p99 jumps when hit_rate < ~78%. Looks like eviction window tuning or prefetch starvation. Try increasing prefetch_window.
maria: Config we ran (eu-west default):
```
pager:
  prefetch_window: 16
  eviction_policy: lru_cost
runtime:
  batch_target_ms: 12
```
bench-bot: Raw snapshot (median of 10 runs):
- eu-west / a100: p50=18ms, p95=72ms, p99=210ms, hit=76%, tput=280 req/s
- us-east / h100: p50=14ms, p95=48ms, p99=98ms, hit=81%, tput=330 req/s
alex: Plots: /charts/kv-slosh/eu-a100.png  /charts/kv-slosh/us-h100.png  — note different kernel scheduling and page-handler latencies. :bar_chart:
min: Did you try toggling the quantized GEMM kernel? Could reduce bandwidth but change prefetch throughput.
maria: We toggled quant-kernel on/off in a small run. Turning it on lowered memory bandwidth but increased p99 variance for long-seq requests (likely due to per-kernel serialization).
devin: Proposed follow-ups:
1) prefetch_window sweep: [8,16,32,64] both regions
2) force fused_attn_v2 on a100 where possible (per-gpu kernel override)
3) synthetic trace with sustained long convo mix (30% >512) to stress pager
rafa: Good. I'll create runs. @min please run the prefetch sweep in eu-west (a100). @devin please run the same in us-east (h100). Keep runs <= 2h and attach raw csvs.
bench-bot: Created bench-run 1719990001, tags: [kv-slosh, slen_60-30-10, sweep_prefetch]. ETA ~1.5h.
maria: Quick capacity note — at hit ~80% we saw headroom drop ~25%. For sizing use p95 + 10% margin.
rafa: Thanks — after the sweeps I'll collate results and propose kernel/eviction defaults to reduce slosh-induced p99s. :thumbsup:
